recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大型、多核或呈花圈樣（wreath-like）核的異型細胞，其中一顆細胞質內含數顆被吞入的紅血球；周圍混有小淋巴球與漿細胞，提示 ALCL 腫瘤細胞吞噬紅血球。
features: Large atypical cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and multiple nuclei arranged in a wreath-like pattern
Nuclei vesicular to coarse with distinct nucleoli; some kidney-shaped forms
One multinucleated tumor cell contains several engulfed red cells; another large cell also contains red cell material
Background of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells
Eosinophilic fibrous stroma in the lower right corner
describe_en: Section (H&E) at high power shows scattered large atypical cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, multiple or wreath-like nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, set in a background of small lymphocytes and plasma cells. One multinucleated atypical cell contains several phagocytosed red cells, and a second large cell contains intracytoplasmic red cell material. Findings are consistent with tumor-cell erythrophagocytosis in anaplastic large cell lymphoma; CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry are required to confirm tumor-cell identity.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD15+/PAX5 weak+ and lack ALK and T-cell/cytotoxic markers, and they rarely show erythrophagocytosis.
Benign hemophagocytes have small bland single nuclei rather than atypical wreath-like multinucleation.
Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus and are CD61/CD42b-positive, not CD30-positive.
Histiocytic sarcoma is CD163/CD68-positive and CD30/ALK-negative.
